roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center. This vital role is crucial for maintaining high standards of patient care and staff competency within our facility.

In this dual-focused position, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, as well as overseeing all aspects of our infection prevention and control initiatives. This includes training new hires, ensuring ongoing staff development, conducting surveillance, and implementing best practices to safeguard the health of our residents and team members. We offer a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in staff development or infection control within a healthcare setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations, including CMS and CDC guidelines
Excellent communication, presentation, and organizational skills
Ability to develop, implement, and evaluate effective educational programs
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00 based on experience.

description:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is a unique opportunity to lead marketing initiatives for a recently acquired center, playing a pivotal role in its growth and community engagement. We are looking for a proactive and results-oriented professional ready to make a significant impact.

This role offers competitive compensation for the right individual, reflecting the importance of this leadership position. The ideal candidate will be a driven professional, comfortable with occasional weekend work, and dedicated to elevating the facility's presence and reputation within the local healthcare landscape.
requirements: Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as a Marketing Director, preferably in a healthcare or skilled nursing facility environment.
Exceptional presentation and interpersonal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to be proactive, resourceful, and results-driven in a competitive market.
Willingness and availability to work occasional weekends.
Proven track record of developing and implementing successful marketing strategies.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and performance.

description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, as a Physical Therapist. In this PRN role, you will provide essential physical therapy services to patients, helping them regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life. This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate and skilled therapist to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.

As a Physical Therapist, you will be responsible for assessing patient needs, developing individualized treatment plans, and implementing therapeutic interventions. You will collaborate closely with other healthcare professionals to ensure comprehensive and coordinated care, contributing to a supportive and patient-focused environment.
requirements: Valid Physical Therapist (PT) license in Florida
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Strong clinical assessment and treatment planning skills
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate for Physical Therapists, Occupational Therapists, and Speech Therapists is $39.00 - $40.00/hr. COTA/PTA roles offer $28.00 - $37.00/hr.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Part-time Remote Radiologist with a New York State license to join our diagnostic imaging team. This role is crucial for interpreting Musculoskeletal (MSK) images, with a specific focus on Workers Compensation and No-Fault (NF) cases. We are looking for an experienced professional who can contribute to our specialized caseload.

This position offers a unique compensation structure based on per-case reads: $50 per MRI, $30 per CT, and $10 per X-Ray. Compensation is heavily weighted towards bonuses. Candidates must be available to work weekends and have a strong background in Workers Compensation or No-Fault/Lien experience, as we do not handle major medical, Medicare, or Medicaid cases.
requirements: Current New York State Radiologist license
Proficiency in reading Musculoskeletal (MSK) images
Demonstrated experience with Workers Compensation and No-Fault (NF) cases
Ability to work weekends
NY WCB (Workers' Compensation Board) number preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is heavily bonus-based, with per-case rates of $50 for MRI, $30 for CT, and $10 for X-Ray reads. Experience with Workers Compensation or No-Fault/Lien cases is essential.

description:
Join a dynamic educational environment in Houston, TX, as a Speech Language Pathologist Assistant (SLPA). This contract role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40/hr+ and is set for an initial 42-week term, starting August 3, 2026. We are seeking a dedicated professional to support students' communication development within a supportive school district setting.

As an SLPA, you will play a crucial role in implementing speech and language services under the supervision of a licensed Speech Language Pathologist. This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on students' lives, helping them achieve their full potential in communication and academic success.

We are looking for a passionate individual ready to contribute to a collaborative team focused on student well-being and growth. If you are eager to apply your skills in a rewarding school-based contract, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Valid Speech Language Pathologist Assistant (SLPA) license/certification in Texas
Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Speech-Language Pathology Assistant program or related field
Experience working with school-aged children preferred
Ability to implement treatment plans and document progress effectively
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
